# ChunkTriangles

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h`](../../../src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h) · Described in `data/renderer.json`

Triangle count of the chunk's mesh, read back from the GPU a few frames after it was built (ray tracing only).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | `uint32_t` | triangles of the mesh (vertexCount / 3 of its indirect command) |
| `slot` | `uint32_t` | slot of the mesh that was counted |

## Notes

Written by the Terrain system NUM_FRAMES frames after the meshing frame, only with ray tracing and only if the chunk still has that slot; removed when the chunk is meshed again. Read by RayScene to build the chunk's acceleration structure.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: RayScene. Written by: Terrain. Created by: Terrain. Destroyed by: Terrain.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Terrain](../systems/Terrain.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | init (storage), tick, destructor (clear) | removed when remeshed; with ray tracing, set NUM_FRAMES later from the read back vertex count |
| [RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md) | service | Host | **read** | updateChunks, on_destroy signal | Triangle count and slot of the chunk's mesh; its destruction frees the structure. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[Terrain](../systems/Terrain.md)**
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin (throws when it is not 256 x 16 bytes) and ./resources/shaders/marchingcubes.comp.glsl.spv in init.
  - Allocates GPU memory: indirect buffer (2048 slots), staging ring (ring size x 8 chunks), lookup texel buffer, a 3 MB vertex buffer per slot (2^15 triangles x 3 vertices x 32 bytes, ray tracing usages when enabled), a readback buffer with ray tracing; descriptor pool and sets, compute pipeline.
  - Records into the compute command buffer of the frame: indirect resets, one dispatch per chunk, a clamp pass, with ray tracing copies of the indirect commands to the readback buffer; Tracy GPU zone "Marching cubes", CPU zone "Mesh chunks", plot "Chunks meshed".
  - Destroys the entities of chunks marked ChunkDestroying (all their components go with them).
  - Logs a warning "Terrain : out of chunk slots" when 2048 slots are used.
  - The destructor waits for the device to be idle and clears its components and TerrainBuffers.
